presets.name: TAR MARROW
presets.description: Immediate, dense corroded bass with a short tail and stable pitch; leaves room for the original long pads.

presets.name: COIL BURROW
presets.description: A low fundamental under a brief branching FM growl; held notes settle into a supportive bass.

presets.name: MOSS CAPACITOR
presets.description: Rounded, clean bass with little drift and a quick release for legible busy patterns; enable FX for restrained folding.

presets.name: CINDER PISTON
presets.description: A harder metallic bass strike with a controlled tail; the abrasive counterpart to MOSS CAPACITOR.

presets.name: HUSK CURRENT
presets.description: Three muted FM pairs decay into silence even while held, for woody syncopated bass plucks.

presets.name: ROOT TERMINAL
presets.description: Soft-edged, nearly clean low notes that support harsh drums without adding another distorted layer.

presets.name: FANG RELAY
presets.description: Focused metallic melody with an immediate attack and a compact tail; distinct from the sprawling BLADE REQUIEM.

presets.name: ION STITCH
presets.description: A wiry forked FM lead: a small pitch bite at the onset, then sustained harmonic tension.

presets.name: VELVET FAULT
presets.description: A softer, warm clean lead with restrained detune; an intimate melody against the broad existing choirs, with mild folding available through FX.

presets.name: SCAR VOLTAGE
presets.description: A narrow bright-edged cutting lead with deep corrosion, but less pitch scatter than SABLE NEEDLES.

presets.name: MOTH CIRCUIT
presets.description: A gently arriving hollow FM lead with a half-frequency undertone and quiet upper modulations.

presets.name: NIGHT SUTURE
presets.description: A slightly moving, open lead with a soft edge and measured release for melody over an atmospheric track.

presets.name: BONE SPARKS
presets.description: Three short FM pairs give a ceramic pitched strike with a flick of high harmonic brightness.

presets.name: VELLUM PRONG
presets.description: A dry, papery short-release key sound; articulation follows your note length rather than an automatic pluck envelope.

presets.name: OXIDE CHIMES
presets.description: A branching metallic chime with quickly fading upper modulation and a lingering pitched carrier.

presets.name: WICKED FELT
presets.description: A muted clean keyboard tone with a fast response and little detune; plays softly beside industrial percussion, with light grit available through FX.

presets.name: GLASS VERTEBRA
presets.description: Twin FM chains with long glassy carrier decays and shorter bright attacks; mostly decays away while held.

presets.name: LANTERN RATTLE
presets.description: A small ringing metallic key sound with moderate corrosion and a useful released-note tail.

presets.name: RIVET WAKE
presets.description: Tight, short-decay mechanical kit for clear rhythmic scaffolding beneath sustained atmospheres.

presets.name: BOILER TEETH
presets.description: Heavy wire-rich coarse percussion with longer ringing body; pairs with cleaner bass and restrained melodic keys.

presets.name: DUST CASKET
presets.description: Muted, lower-bite kit with restrained wire noise and short decay; space for sharper FM lead attacks.

presets.name: CHROME FUNERAL
presets.description: Wire-rich, longer-decay metallic kit for sparse patterns and cymbal textures.

presets.name: VEIN WEATHER
presets.description: A slow shaded pad with modest fracture and gentle filter motion; less spectral glare than the bright original choirs.

presets.name: NOCTILUCE VAT
presets.description: Six softly arriving parallel harmonics form a dusky organ bed without a hard transient.

presets.name: LICHEN VECTOR
presets.description: A dim, drifting filtered layer with small afterimages; complements a clean held bass and short percussion.

presets.name: SUTURE FOG
presets.description: A slowly blooming metallic mist with less extreme corrosion than BLADE REQUIEM and a long released tail.

presets.name: HOLLOW EMBER
presets.description: A broad warm-corroded sustained pad with mild drift and no periodic LFO, leaving rhythms to the other tracks.

presets.name: PHANTOM LOOM
presets.description: A slowly opening six-stage FM chain with quiet upper modulation and gentle ramped filter motion.

presets.name: SULFUR TONGUE
presets.description: Owner-approved metallic tongue revision; original stored ID retained for old songs.

presets.name: WICKED FELT
presets.description: Owner-approved dry FM v2 revision; original stored ID retained for old songs.

presets.name: ASH CHOIR
presets.description: Dark breath swell: slow attack, soft low-pass, gently beating stereo.

presets.name: RUST HALO
presets.description: Rusty struck tine: strong initial metallic transient which decays into a soft fundamental.

presets.name: BLACK GLASS
presets.description: Hard black-glass mallet: inharmonic attack, no held organ sustain.

presets.name: VEIL ENGINE
presets.description: Veiled rising sweep: long bloom and broad slow ramp.

presets.name: CHAPEL GLASS
presets.description: Chapel glass bell: two long decaying partial clusters, no constant sustained carrier.

presets.name: WIRE HYMNS
presets.description: Plucked wire with a brief falling spectral attack and a thin sustained core.

presets.name: ASHEN TIDE
presets.description: Wide tidal beating with a much quicker brightness cycle.

presets.name: GRAVE CLOCK
presets.description: Dry wooden clock tick: fast amplitude decay, slightly pitched downward transient.

presets.name: NOCTURNE 13
presets.description: Almost-static low dark drone: gradual onset and exceptionally long fade.

presets.name: SALT STATIC
presets.description: Short noisy salt burst: high-ratio sidebands dissolve quickly.

presets.name: CATHODE MOTH
presets.description: Narrow insect chirp: rising pitch onset, fading upper spectrum.

presets.name: IRON PSALM
presets.description: Dry hammered iron: immediate aggressive ring, very short tail.

presets.name: FURNACE VOW
presets.description: Slow furnace rise with dark beating overtones.

presets.name: SHARD CROWN
presets.description: Sharp crystalline shard: sparse high odd-ratio carriers, short bright ping.

presets.name: ANVIL SERAPH
presets.description: Long resonant anvil with a clear bright initial strike.

presets.name: VOLT TEETH
presets.description: Brittle electrical buzz with fast pulse movement.

presets.name: RUST TALON
presets.description: Tight claw bass: half-ratio sub plus a short rasp transient.

presets.name: BLADE REQUIEM
presets.description: Long bowed-metal sweep, strongly detuned and slow to bloom.

presets.name: TOMB CURRENT
presets.description: Hollow tomb bass: clean half-ratio body under an octave knock.

presets.name: SLAG PULSE
presets.description: Short dark industrial pulse; minimal ring.

presets.name: QUAKE ENGINE
presets.description: Low filtered quake with a slow heavy tail.

presets.name: HOLLOW ROOT
presets.description: Pure decaying sub: low sine body with almost no upper harmonic content.

presets.name: GRIT PILGRIM
presets.description: Forward gritty strike; narrow pitch beating and short damp.

presets.name: OBSIDIAN KEYS
presets.description: Obsidian muted electric key: woody transient and fast damping, velocity expressive.

presets.name: SULFUR TONGUE
presets.description: Sulfur reed: snarling short modulator transient into a nasal sustained carrier.

presets.name: TARNISH BELL
presets.description: Tarnished tubular bell: wide noninteger-like partial spacing and very long decay.

presets.name: SABLE NEEDLES
presets.description: Needle staccato: high bright additive spikes, nearly instant damping.

presets.name: GRAVE HAMMER
presets.description: Heavy hammer bass: brief downward pitch strike followed by a round decay.

presets.name: PALLID CHOIR
presets.description: Pale shifting choir: three unusual carrier ratios with staggered spectral decay.

presets.name: MIRROR INK
presets.description: Mirrored delayed-onset partials: six additive tones arrive at different times and decay independently.

presets.name: RIVEN SIGNAL
presets.description: Broken radio pulse: dense nested sidebands, short bright chirp then sparse sustain.

presets.name: NERVE CHOIR
presets.description: Breathing FM choir: carrier swells while modulators fade, shifting from rough to pure.

presets.name: CRUCIBLE
presets.description: Crucible brass: quick spectral flare into a strong broad held tone.

presets.name: BONE WIRE
presets.description: Bone wire harp: two contrasting plucked strings with nearly absent sustain.

presets.name: SPECTRAL GRAFT
presets.description: Spectral graft: staggered FM swells and unequal releases, slowly changing overtone balance.

presets.name: TAR MARROW
presets.description: Thick low tar grind with audible moving sidebands.

presets.name: COIL BURROW
presets.description: Coiled acid bass: bright short squelch over a low held sub carrier.

presets.name: MOSS CAPACITOR
presets.description: Damped moss pulse with asymmetrical brightness opening.

presets.name: CINDER PISTON
presets.description: Sharp piston click with rapid gate-like colour.

presets.name: HUSK CURRENT
presets.description: Dry husk marimba: low, rounded paired plucks with a short upper knock.

presets.name: ROOT TERMINAL
presets.description: Terminal sub thud: short filtered amplitude decay and a deep downward pitch transient.

presets.name: FANG RELAY
presets.description: Fanged sync-like lead: harsh nested modulation with a sharp decaying bite.

presets.name: ION STITCH
presets.description: Ionic rising laser: obvious upward pitch sweep with a bright rapidly thinning tail.

presets.name: VELVET FAULT
presets.description: Velvet thumb piano: soft low-partial pluck, short release and no held sustain.

presets.name: SCAR VOLTAGE
presets.description: Bright scarred stereo tremor with moderate ring.

presets.name: MOTH CIRCUIT
presets.description: Moth shimmer: delayed upper partials, high overtone cluster and soft irregular decay.

presets.name: NIGHT SUTURE
presets.description: Night suture: soft dark struck chord voice with unequal additive decays.

presets.name: BONE SPARKS
presets.description: Bone sparks: three tiny bell attacks with very high short sidebands.

presets.name: VELLUM PRONG
presets.description: Vellum prong: dry low metallic kalimba with a pitched paper-like transient.

presets.name: OXIDE CHIMES
presets.description: Oxide chimes: bright six-tone cluster with progressively longer high partial decays.

presets.name: WICKED FELT
presets.description: Wicked felt piano: hard hammer transient into three muted decaying partial pairs.

presets.name: GLASS VERTEBRA
presets.description: Glass vertebra: thin high struck glass with a long low body and short high splinters.

presets.name: LANTERN RATTLE
presets.description: Lantern rattle: noisy short falling ring, high feedback and rapidly decaying modulators.

presets.name: DUST CASKET
presets.description: Long dirty high-body kit: noisy wire and extended ringing decay.

presets.name: CHROME FUNERAL
presets.description: Bright tight tuned kit: raised body pitch, dry wire, sharply damped decay.

presets.name: VEIN WEATHER
presets.description: Hard-edged pulsing weather: strong square-wave timbral motion.

presets.name: NOCTILUCE VAT
presets.description: Noctiluce bowed glass: very slow additive rise with soft dissonant partial entries.

presets.name: LICHEN VECTOR
presets.description: Fast drifting stereo ramp with a shorter attack than the other pads.

presets.name: SUTURE FOG
presets.description: Soft inharmonic fog, extreme detuning and restrained drive.

presets.name: HOLLOW EMBER
presets.description: Hollow ember: low decaying sine with a small hot overtone which dies much faster.

presets.name: PHANTOM LOOM
presets.description: Phantom loom: slow spectral crossing; modulators swell after the carrier, then thin out.
